work_experience.description:
1. Design and build the scalable architecture and infrastructure
2. Build the technology team and double the strength in 3 months.
3. Mentoring the new joiners
4. Work closely with Sales, Marketing/SEO, Data and Content team for technology requirements and implementation.
5. Evaluate new cutting edge technologies and check the viability with current product implementation.

Being a developer at heart half of my effort still goes in execution and implementation. Rest of the time  my focus is to manage end to end product lifecycle which includes Product Strategy, Product Evolution, Ownership of product roadmap and driving/leading product launches, co-ordinating across design, marketing, communications and content teams, listening closely to user requirements
Leading end to end product development in ixigo specially the new product trip planner. Currently, I am working with team of 9 people.

I handle the backend development of each and every project at ixigo which includes architecture design, development, QA, deployment strategies, releases etc. I preferably work on Java, J2EE, JibX, mysql, MongoDB, Caching Framework and other cutting edge technologies like varnish, solr, spring mongo data etc.

I was a part of Oracle retail in which i have developed many modules of one of the main product in retail called "Store Inventory Mangement". Apart from that i was also involved in using the Oracle SOA into various retail products.

I was a part of Oracle COE which basically works on Oracle Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) and its various aspects. I was a part of many ERP implementations which accenture has done for various prestigious clients in india and abroad.

received.caption: June 24, 2017, Aloke was senior to Vineet but didn't manage Vineet directly
received.text: Vineet was a key pillar of strength in ixigo's journey, and contributed immensely to our growth. His execution and self-learning capabilities set a very high gold standard for the rest of the tech and product team to follow, and his ability to solve complex challenges blazingly fast and with limited resources sets him apart among his peers. In terms of leadership, he not only held the team together,  but also stepped up to the leadership team and shouldered wider responsibilities that he saw no-one else taking in the company. He is also a risk-taker who provided much needed support and stepped up the momentum even during the tougher days. We still miss him.

received.caption: June 14, 2017, Dhruv reported directly to Vineet
received.text: Vineet is a "Renaissance man".  Few people have the opportunity to report to a manager who is also a coach and mentor — but I did when I worked for Vineet. I’ve had the pleasure of working with Vineet for 3 years, during which I have seen him evolve from a developer, with excellent problem solving skills, to an astute manager, who would communicate across teams for better coordination,  to a leader with deep understanding of technology. Above all, I was impressed with his ability to motivate, coach and produce results from people. Ixigo has gone through some of the most rapid series of changes/pivots successfully under his guidance. And, of course, we would miss him as our opening batsman on our office cricket team. Also, no matter how tense a meeting/discussion, Vineet would make sure everyone left with a smile. If I ever get the chance, I would love to work for him again.
